strong_suit: Slow (belly-slides through enemies and slows them)
axis: studio = (-x, z, y) of blender; Blender front -Y = Studio front -Z
units: studs; the model is at final size, import 1:1 and do not scale
sides: L/R are the penguin's own left/right; its left is Blender +X = Studio -X
origin: all positions are relative to the model origin = the ground point under the body pivot (Blender world origin)
texture_note: one shared atlas; every MeshPart uses the same TextureID via MeshPart.TextureID (Common rarity: no Neon, no glow)
rest_rotation: every part has identity rotation relative to the model at rest
rig: one Motor6D per part: Part0 = joint_parent, Part1 = the part, C0/C1 placed at the part's pivot

Penguin_Body.suggested_motion: root part: waddle roll about Studio Z, bob in Studio Y, belly-slide pitch forward about Studio X

Penguin_Head.suggested_motion: nod = pitch about Studio X, tilt = roll about Studio Z, look = yaw about Studio Y, through the neck joint

Penguin_FlipperL.suggested_motion: flap = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the shoulder; out = NEGATIVE Studio Z angle for the left flipper (tip moves to Studio -X)

Penguin_FlipperR.suggested_motion: flap = rotate about Studio Z (front-back axis) through the shoulder; out = POSITIVE Studio Z angle for the right flipper

Penguin_FootL.suggested_motion: waddle = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

Penguin_FootR.suggested_motion: waddle = swing about Studio X (side-to-side axis) through the hip

locomotion_data.gait: waddle: short quick steps, body rocks side to side, flippers held out and counter-swinging
locomotion_data.angle_convention: degrees, rotation of the part about its own pivot in Studio axes (right-hand rule, Roblox CFrame.Angles); Blender bone angles in the previews are noted alongside

waddle.Penguin_Body: roll about Studio Z +/-10 deg alternating each step, bob +0.04 studs in Studio Y at mid-step
waddle.Penguin_FootL: swing about Studio X between +24 and -24 deg (opposite phase to FootR)
waddle.Penguin_FootR: swing about Studio X between -24 and +24 deg
waddle.Penguin_FlipperL: Studio Z between -35 and -12 deg (out, pulsing; out is negative on the left)
waddle.Penguin_FlipperR: Studio Z between +12 and +35 deg (counter-phase to the left)
waddle.Penguin_Head: counter-roll about Studio Z of -4 deg against the body roll so the face stays level

slide_pose.note: belly-slide: the penguin tips onto its belly and glides head first through enemies, slowing them
slide_pose.Penguin_Body: pitch forward about Studio X by -78 deg (Blender +78 about X; the head tips toward Studio -Z); the belly then lies about 0.1 studs above the ground with the body pivot left where it is
slide_pose.Penguin_Head: pitch about Studio X by +45 deg (chin up, looking ahead) relative to the tipped body
slide_pose.Penguin_FlipperL: Studio Z -30 deg (swept out and back along the body, which is already behind the shoulder after the tip)
slide_pose.Penguin_FootL: swing about Studio X by +20 deg (toes trail behind)
slide_pose.Penguin_FootR: swing about Studio X by +20 deg
slide_pose.ground_contact: belly front-bottom; slide with the body pivot 0.8 studs above the ground and no extra offset
